UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Publicly scoped user account profile linked to Firebase Authentication (GitHub OAuth or Google OAuth) with PII isolated.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

githubUsername.description: GitHub login username from OAuth profile.

providerId.description: Primary OAuth provider identifier (e.g. github.com or google.com).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the user profile was first created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the user profile was last updated.

UserPrivateInfo.title: UserPrivateInfo
UserPrivateInfo.description: Isolated PII subcollection document storing user email address.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID owning this private record.

email.description: User email address from OAuth provider.

AuditHistoryRecord.title: AuditHistoryRecord
AuditHistoryRecord.description: Saved code audit snapshot with before-vs-after performance, accessibility, best-practices, SEO, and security impact metrics and selected commits.

auditId.description: Unique identifier of the saved audit record.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who saved this audit.

runPhase.description: Audit run phase: static (Run 1) or lhr (Run 2 Lighthouse JSON).

totalCommitsCount.description: Total number of generated atomic commits in the audit.

selectedCommitsCount.description: Number of commits selected for the patch / PR.

performanceBefore.description: Baseline Performance metric index (0-100) before selected commits.

performanceAfter.description: Projected Performance metric index (0-100) after applying selected commits.

accessibilityBefore.description: Baseline Accessibility metric index (0-100) before selected commits.

accessibilityAfter.description: Projected Accessibility metric index (0-100) after applying selected commits.

bestPracticesBefore.description: Baseline Best Practices metric index (0-100) before selected commits.

bestPracticesAfter.description: Projected Best Practices metric index (0-100) after applying selected commits.

seoBefore.description: Baseline SEO metric index (0-100) before selected commits.

seoAfter.description: Projected SEO metric index (0-100) after applying selected commits.

securityBefore.description: Baseline Web Application Security hygiene index (0-100) before selected commits.

securityAfter.description: Projected Web Application Security hygiene index (0-100) after applying selected commits.

summaryNotes.description: Summary of categories and key metrics improved by the selected commits.

commitTitles.description: Bounded list (max 25) of imperative commit headlines included in this saved audit.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the audit was saved.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the saved audit was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: User account profile document keyed by Firebase Auth UID (PII excluded).

/users/{userId}/private/{docId}.description: Isolated PII subcollection storing private user email.

/users/{userId}/audits/{auditId}.description: Saved audit history subcollection stored directly under the authenticated user's Firestore profile.

/audits/{auditId}.description: Saved personal audit history records containing before-vs-after metric impact and selected commit summaries.
